description: Choose score or monitor, paste companies, and select the buying signals to check.

companies.description: Advanced list. Each item can include companyName (or name), domain, careersUrl, ats, atsToken and disambiguator. Plain strings are also accepted. If provided, this overrides the text list.

ats.description: Optional provider name when you already know it: greenhouse, ashby, lever, workable, smartrecruiters, recruitee, personio, breezy or workday.
ats.title: ATS provider

atsToken.description: Optional board token for the provider, e.g. the token in jobs.ashbyhq.com/linear.
atsToken.title: ATS token

careersUrl.description: Optional careers page or job-board URL, e.g. https://jobs.lever.co/acme.
careersUrl.title: Careers URL

companyName.description: The company's legal or brand name.
companyName.title: Company Name

disambiguator.description: Optional word that must appear in news headlines, e.g. software for a common-word company name.
disambiguator.title: Disambiguator

domain.description: Optional root domain, e.g. notion.so. Avoids domain lookup.
domain.title: Domain

companies.title: Companies (advanced)

companiesText.description: Paste company names, one per line. Domains and careers URLs are accepted in the advanced list below.
companiesText.title: Companies (one per line)

emitUnchanged.description: (mode=monitor) Include companies with no new or resolved signals and no score change.
emitUnchanged.title: Emit unchanged companies

includeRawSignals.description: In full output, add sample job titles and the top news headlines for auditing.
includeRawSignals.title: Include raw evidence

lookbackDays.description: Funding, news and executive-change window. News trend counts also cover 7, 30 and 90 days.
lookbackDays.title: Lookback days

maxCompanies.description: Hard cap on companies processed per run.
maxCompanies.title: Max companies

maxConcurrency.description: How many companies to process in parallel. Lower values are gentler on public sources.
maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency

minScore.description: Drop scored companies below this intent score. Error records are always kept.
minScore.title: Minimum score

mode.description: Score every company, or compare this run with the previous run for the same monitor key.
mode.title: Mode

monitorKey.description: (mode=monitor) Name of the tracking history. Use the same key each run to compare against the previous snapshot.
monitorKey.title: Monitor key

outputFormat.description: compact returns ranking fields plus top signals. full adds the score breakdown and per-signal detail.
outputFormat.title: Output format

signals.description: Buying signals to check. Disabling a scored signal normalizes the remaining weights to 100.
signals.title: Signals

targetTechnology.description: Optional technology to check on the company homepage, e.g. HubSpot or Marketo. The gap result does not change the intent score.
targetTechnology.title: Target technology

title: B2B Sales Trigger Intelligence Input
